## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

Describe how the change was validated against the Issue's expected outcome.

## Required post-merge verification

List genuinely required post-merge-only checks, their expected results and current status, or state "None." Follow the [merge, closure and follow-up lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#pre-merge-acceptance-and-post-merge-verification) for evidence and discovered defects; do not report pending or blocked checks as passed.

## Related issues

Link the Issue(s) this PR addresses. Retain `Closes #N` when implementation and mandatory pre-merge acceptance are complete, even if post-merge-only verification is pending; see the [publication and partial-work rules](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#implement-and-propose-a-pull-request).

## Scope check

- [ ] This PR fully addresses each Issue it claims to resolve.
- [ ] This PR does not include unrelated work.
- [ ] This PR does not add speculative abstractions, extensibility, frameworks, or subsystems that are not needed by the Issue.
- [ ] Any intentionally partial implementation is clearly stated, and the parent Issue is not presented as fully resolved unless the remaining scope has been explicitly split out.
- [ ] Validation maps to the Issue's expected outcome / acceptance criteria.
